content.title: Waystar Q2 beat: CEO talks AI in healthcare, Iodine acquisition
content.description:
Shares of healthcare-payments software firm Waystar (WAY) are getting a lift after the company reported second quarter results that beat analyst expectations on both the top and bottom lines. Waystar also raised its full-year outlook.

Waystar CEO Matt Hawkins joins Market Domination with Josh Lipton to discuss the company's earnings results, the healthcare sector's adoption of artificial intelligence (AI), and Waystar's recent acquisition of software company Iodine.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.
